groups.name: app
groups.description: Pilar Estilo application settings. Most leaves are injected with @Value rather than @ConfigurationProperties, so they carry no generated metadata; this file declares the namespace so IDEs stop reporting it as an unknown property.

groups.name: app.analytics
groups.description: Server-side product analytics (PostHog): the money events the browser cannot be trusted to deliver.

groups.name: app.gateway
groups.description: Per-IP rate limiting on auth and webhook endpoints.

groups.name: app.password-reset
groups.description: Self-service password reset link generation and cleanup.

groups.name: app.payment
groups.description: Payment gateway and remote payment-service delegation.

groups.name: app.system-settings
groups.description: Encryption of secrets stored in system_settings.

properties.name: app.cache.redis.enabled
properties.description: Registers the Redis connection factory. Without a reachable Redis the app will not start.

properties.name: app.documents.orphan-sweep.cron
properties.description: When to delete uploaded files no document claims.

properties.name: app.documents.orphan-sweep.min-age-hours
properties.description: How old an unclaimed file must be before the sweep takes it; younger ones are still on their way to being claimed.

properties.name: app.documents.storage-path
properties.description: Private root for boletas and transfer receipts; read only through authenticated endpoints.

properties.name: app.analytics.posthog.enabled
properties.description: Send order_created / order_paid to PostHog. Off unless a project key is set.

properties.name: app.analytics.posthog.host
properties.description: PostHog ingestion host. US region by default; must match the storefront snippet's region.

properties.name: app.analytics.posthog.api-key
properties.description: PostHog project token (phc_…). Write-only; the frontend ships the same value in HTML.

properties.name: app.analytics.posthog.timeout-ms
properties.description: Connect and read timeout for the capture call. Clamped to [500, 30000].

properties.name: app.domain-events.kafka.enabled
properties.description: Makes KafkaDomainEventPublisher primary, which leaves every in-process @EventListener dead.

properties.name: app.gateway.rate-limit.enabled
properties.description: Per-IP limits on auth and webhook endpoints.

properties.name: app.gateway.rate-limit.forgot-password-max-requests
properties.description: Per-IP cap on POST /api/auth/forgot-password within the rate-limit window.

properties.name: app.google.tokeninfo-url
properties.description: Google's OAuth2 tokeninfo endpoint, prefix before the id_token query value. Overridable so tests can point it at a local stand-in.

properties.name: app.jwt.secret
properties.description: HS256 signing key, base64-encoded, minimum 32 bytes.

properties.name: app.password-reset.link-base-url
properties.description: Storefront origin the reset link points at, no trailing slash.

properties.name: app.password-reset.token-ttl-minutes
properties.description: Minutes a password-reset link stays valid.

properties.name: app.password-reset.cleanup-cron
properties.description: Cron for pruning expired password-reset tokens.

properties.name: app.media.storage-path
properties.description: Filesystem path where product media is written.

properties.name: app.product-ai.enabled
properties.description: Runs the AI job worker. Off means the cron never fires and no paid API is called.

properties.name: app.product-ai.engine
properties.description: 'stub' short-circuits to the fake pipeline; any other value routes to app.product-ai.openai.base-url, which is what picks the provider.

properties.name: app.social-publishing.meta.instagram.container-poll-interval-ms
properties.description: Wait between checks of an Instagram media container's status_code before publishing it.

properties.name: app.social-publishing.meta.instagram.container-poll-max-attempts
properties.description: How many times to poll an Instagram media container for FINISHED before giving up.

properties.name: app.social-publishing.schedule.cron
properties.description: Cron for the scheduled-publication job. Default: every minute.

properties.name: app.social-publishing.schedule.max-lateness-minutes
properties.description: A SCHEDULED publication more than this many minutes overdue is failed instead of published.

properties.name: app.system-settings.crypto-secret
properties.description: Key used to encrypt secrets at rest in system_settings. Falls back to app.jwt.secret.
